rules.accepted_credit_types: ACPE-approved programs or programs approved by the Board (non-ACPE programs need a CE Evaluation Application)
rules.new_licensee_rule: New graduates are not exempt from reporting: they report the pharmacy school and enrollment dates for the previous calendar year instead of courses.
rules.audit_note: For Board CE audits, NABP CPE Monitor documents ACPE-accredited courses; Board-approved sponsors issue certificates.
rules.notes: 15 clock hours earned in the previous calendar year; annual renewal in the birth month. CE details (program, ACPE# or sponsor, date, hours) are entered at renewal; ACPE credit requires an NABP e-Profile/CPE Monitor. Late fee $100 (16 days after expiration).
rules.rule_quote: No annual renewal certificate shall be issued to a pharmacist until such pharmacist has submitted proof to the Board that he has participated in not less than fifteen (15) clock hours of continuing education obtained through the satisfactory completion of an accredited program of continuing professional education during the previous calendar year.
